title: Gotrade Daily: Broadcom Beat, But the Stock Still Fell
summary: Broadcom beat every estimate and still fell about 5%. Tonight the AI-chip complex faces a test: is the trade priced for perfection?
body_markdown:
### Yields at cycle highs, oil still hot


The 10-year Treasury yield touched 4.818% on Wednesday, its highest since November 2023. WTI crude rose almost 1% to $91 amid tensions with Iran. High yields and expensive oil are natural headwinds for richly valued stocks like AI chips.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


The price figures in the Watchlist above are Wednesday's official closing prices (2 Sep). One important note: Broadcom reported after Wednesday's bell, so the roughly 5% drop is not yet reflected in AVGO's official close above. US markets were not open when this Watchlist was built. The early tone leans cautious: the AI-chip complex faces a sentiment test after Broadcom's reaction. Watch Nasdaq futures into the bell as a risk-appetite signal.


## Macro Note 📝


Rising bond yields and a lingering hawkish Fed tone still weigh on risk assets. The US dollar is firmer and gold is easing. High oil is the inflation wildcard that could keep rate expectations tight.


## Conclusion


Tonight is not about whether Broadcom is good, because the numbers are clearly strong. It is about how much good news is already in the price. AVGO's reaction, and how[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) ,[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) , and[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) follow, could set the direction for the AI-chip trade over the next few days.
